abort.already_configured: Reapplied the YAML block for this room.
abort.yaml_only: PID Climate is configured in YAML, under the climate: platform key. There is nothing to set up here.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Re-read the pid_climate blocks from configuration.yaml and apply any changes, without restarting Home Assistant. Rooms whose config is unchanged are left running; only edited ones reload.

set_integral.name: Set integral
set_integral.description: Force the integral term for one mode. A diagnostic escape hatch: if you need it regularly, the mode's offset is wrong.

value.name: Value
value.description: Integral value, in degrees of command.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Which mode's integral to set. Defaults to the active mode.

reset_integral.name: Reset integral
reset_integral.description: Zero the integral for one mode, or for all modes if none is given.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Which mode's integral to reset. Defaults to all modes.

clear_hold.name: Clear hold
clear_hold.description: Drop any outstanding target-change hold so integration resumes immediately, instead of waiting out the remaining time.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Which mode's hold to clear. Defaults to all modes.
